name: Time Changes Friends
jem_summary: Change your owned Antlion’s phase with a fully durable Hourglass and lock an eligible minion’s chosen phase with chains.

pages.title: Time Changes Friends
pages.text: Change your owned Antlion’s phase with a fully durable Hourglass and lock an eligible minion’s chosen phase with chains.

pages.title: Time Changes Friends
pages.text: Antlion Fur and Crystallized Blood supply further work with companion forms.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The Hourglass needs full durability for its native action. Chains lock the minion’s phase; they do not grant dimension access or alter campaign rules.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use a fully durable Hourglass on a tamed Antlion or activate a Respawn Totem. Hourglass cycles its phase; Netherite Chains lock phase shifting on a tamed minion.
